page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 16 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core CPU performance is weak, scoring in the bottom 25% on stress-ng and bottom 10% on Geekbench. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds for large blocks, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance provides a memory-optimized profile designed for workloads requiring significant memory capacity without demanding high single-threaded compute performance. Appropriate workloads include database operations, Redis caching, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing. The dedicated CPU allocation offers predictable multi-core execution, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-dense workloads that can tolerate lower single-core speeds.
